answer: Each agent posts its answer hash to the knoll bulletin board in the first four hours of the epoch and locks a 150 POA anchor bond with it. In the last hour, the agent submits the full answer and signs a fresh signal nonce; peers check that the reveal matches the anchored hash. Missing, late, or mismatched reveals slash the whole bond—half burned, half to the peer who caught it. One thousand clones lock 150,000 POA and must stay online through both windows just to avoid burns; one copycat answer across keys slashes every clone at once. Trust is the knot that holds the net.
